long_biography.plain_text:
Segrave began flying while studying mathematics and computer science at East Carolina University. A Piper Saratoga, financed with a loan his father co-signed, became the starting point for a parts-transport operation. He founded Segrave Aviation in Kinston in 1994 and expanded it into charter, maintenance and airport services. Delta Air Lines later acquired the company, after which he led Delta Private Jets for three years.

When his non-compete expired, Segrave founded flyExclusive in 2015. He replaced the managed-aircraft model with a standardized, company-controlled fleet and developed in-house painting, interiors, maintenance and avionics capability. The business later added jet membership and fractional ownership programmes before becoming publicly traded. Segrave remains founder, chairman and chief executive, retains majority voting control, and continues to fly professionally.
